content: {"episode_id":"ep-05001","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), for which prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes and to assess for potential cardioembolic sources."}
